copy.title: Deepin Risk · Company Intelligence
copy.description: Look deep into every company's history, relationships and risks. Deepin tracks changes at your customers, suppliers, dealers and business partners and explains what they mean, with evidence.
copy.hero_lede: Your customers, suppliers, dealers and business partners keep changing. Deepin tracks these changes and explains what they mean, with evidence. Your team makes the call.
copy.mon_h2: Companies don't stay the same. Why should their risk report?
copy.mon_lede: Traditional risk assessment is a snapshot. Deepin keeps company intelligence live: a material change causes the company to be looked at again.
copy.mon_hint: Select an event to see what changed.
copy.dim_lede: Deepin looks at a company from four angles and asks the same questions again every time it changes.
copy.ev_h2: Don't tell me the score. Show me why.
copy.ev_lede: Supplier Co.'s risk moved from Medium to High. Every change comes with its finding, its source and the reasoning; your team makes the call.
copy.layer_lede: Data providers give you company data. Deepin Risk turns it into researched, evidence-backed context and makes your company intelligence complete.
copy.uses_h2: One Company Intelligence capability. A different decision in every sector.
copy.uses_lede: The same capability serves credit decisions in banking, merchant decisions in fintech and supplier decisions in industry.
copy.proof_h2: Company Intelligence is already running in production.
copy.proof_lede: The same Company Intelligence capability is already being used across different enterprise decisions. Each customer is shown at the maturity it has actually reached.
copy.ent_h2: Built for the data you cannot send outside.
copy.ent_data_p: Your watchlists, analyses and decisions remain yours. What improves across deployments is how Deepin analyzes, never your records.
copy.cta_h2: Give Deepin a company to look into.
copy.cta_p: Pick a company your team already knows. See what changed, what Deepin finds and the evidence behind it.
copy.value_tagline: From event to decision: in seconds, with evidence.
copy.layer_note: Works alongside your existing risk stack; it doesn't replace your workflow, it gives it decision-ready context.

SOCAR.quote: In supplier assessment we see not just a score but the reason behind it. Our procurement team can now defend its decisions with the source.

start.p: Send the customers, suppliers or dealers you want to track. You can also start with a single company.
Deepin lays out each company's history, relationships and material changes, with the evidence.
When something material changes, you see what it means and the recommendation right away; your team makes the call.
